sections.text:
Ability Power 180. Damages all enemies 2 times with physical star damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases the ATK and MATK of all allies by 20% for 60 seconds.
ATK and MATK increasing effect boosted by 5% for each increase in Skill level.
-Decreases the DEF and MDEF of all allies by 20% for 60 seconds [Demerit].
-Recovers 15 Cost for your character.
